post.summary: Chat with Murshid: an orchestrator routes to specialist sub-agents (academics, sports, opportunities, career/CV, planner, business, wellbeing)
post.description: JSON by default. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the reply streams as SSE events: `route` {agents, names, reason, router}, `agent-start` {agent, name, models}, `agent-tool` {agent, tool}, `agent-done` {agent, ms, fallback, model} (live, while the sub-agents work), then `meta` {intent, lang, threadId, generatedBy}, `text-delta` {delta}, `tool-call` {name, args}, `done` (full ChatResponse incl. `agents` trace). Accepts {message} or assistant-ui style {messages:[{role, content}]} (content may be a string or text parts). Quick lookups use the deterministic rule agent when no model is configured; every sub-agent falls back to rules if its models fail.

agents.description: which sub-agents ran, their tools, models tried, latency and whether they fell back to rules

buddy.description: study buddy turn: which guardrail fired (flags), what produced the reply, limits

messages.description: assistant-ui style thread; the last user message is answered when `message` is absent

persona.description: tutor (default) or the optional study buddy persona (guardrailed; school/guardian can switch it off)
